implementation.name: original-v1-gradient-descent
implementation.scope: Exact original illustrative quadratic and authored two learning-rate traces; markers follow discrete optimizer updates, not measured training or time.
implementation.question: Why does a larger learning rate cross the minimum yet reduce loss more slowly?

purpose: Expose the signed local slope and update arithmetic while following both original trajectories.
storyboard: Establish identical starting weight and loss.
Apply each authored update on both panels, retaining exact original curve and traces.
Compare final losses and the repeated overshoot cost.
guard: The large rate still converges for this quadratic. No claim about a universally optimal rate, nonconvex convergence, or runtime. Pointers in flight do not indicate committed optimizer states.
